_comment: xiaohui_v1 的 PA40 变体 (rv64, 用于 C9205 等 PA40 器件): 唯一差异是 aplic 的 IMSIC 基址落在 PA40(40 位物理地址)范围 — imsics_m 0xf000000000 / imsics_s 0xf010000000, 对应 xiaohui_v1 PA48 的 0xf00000000000 / 0xf00010000000。plic 块与 v1 一致, 故须配 -intc aplic 才体现差异。默认 DDR = 7G (--memsize 8G 可改)。

gmac._comment: GMAC 有三种模式(由 -gmac 选项 / CPU 自动决定):h100 = 默认 HAPS/H100 FPGA 网卡,socinit 用 init.mode_h100 写序列(net_mode=0);h100_v2 = c930/c925 自动切换的变体,socinit 用 init.mode_haps_v2 写序列(net_mode=1);pro = 独立 pro 网卡(-gmac pro),走 gmac_pro dtsi 模板、无此处 init 写序列。

hsm._comment: HSM/power-management config: hsm.pmc drives the DTS pmc node (-pmc) and the socinit IPMC writes; hsm.pcu.boot_release drives the gdbinit reset/release sequence. xiaohui_v1_pa40 has no hsm.pcu (no PCU hardware).

boot_release._comment: Boot hart-release config (v1 = PMC-v1-style hart release, used by c906/c907/c908/c920). reset_addrs = per-hart reset vector regs (set to $zsb_addr). Global release reg (release_addr) defaults to 0xff (<=8 cores) and widens to release_layout (>8 cores). v1 has no per-hart release/config writes (no release_addrs). NOTE: boot_release v1/v2 names the hart-release generation, distinct from both the -pmc DTS node (hsm.pmc) and the PCU HSM node version (hsm.pcu.version).

intc._comment: v1 supports both PLIC (default) and APLIC (--intc aplic override), each in its own sub-block. The aplic.mtimer node is emitted only on CPUs lacking Sstc (extension-driven); Sstc CPUs use stimecmp and omit it.

imsics_m.desc: IMSIC M-mode, base 属 PA40 地址范围 (size scales with core count)

imsics_s.desc: IMSIC S-mode, base 属 PA40 地址范围 (size scales with core count)

mtimer.desc: ACLINT mtimer (APLIC path on non-Sstc CPUs)

link_ip._comment: Interconnect/link IP by generation. ncore=NCore coherence bus (--bus ncore); xl200=XuanTie Link 200 (--bus stlk/stlk2); xl100 reserved. xl300 (--bus stlk3) is v2-only and intentionally absent here.

ncore._comment: Snoop/DVM regs derived as cluster_base + i*snoop_stride + snoop_offset (snoop) and cluster_base + dvm_offset (dvm). cluster0 has 4 snoop regs, cluster1 has 1.

chosen._comment_initrd: initrd.end is a placeholder (0x0); the boot script backfills the real end address after it computes the rootfs size.

images_layout._comment: Boot image load addresses consumed by the gdb scripts (zsb.gdbinit + zsb_socinit.gdbinit).

optee._comment: OP-TEE boot: kernel/rootfs in the 0x8xxxxxxx window (matches optee DTS linux,initrd-start=0x84000000); bl31 secure monitor + tee-os secure.
